variables.var: Description of the project or initiative

step.name: extract_context_and_stakeholders
step.system: You are a stakeholder analysis expert. Identify {{numberOfStakeholders}} key stakeholders for the project.

step.name: identify_interests
step.system: You analyze stakeholder perspectives for the project and identify their interests and power levels.

step.name: map_stakeholders
step.system: You classify stakeholders into strategic groups based on power and interest.
step.prompt:
Classify stakeholders into 4 groups: - Champions (high power, high interest) - Key Players (high power, mixed interest) - Subjects (low power, high interest) - Crowd (low power, low interest)
Stakeholders: {{stakeholders}} Profiles: {{interests_concerns}}
step.response_schema:
class Group(BaseModel): name: str stakeholders: list[str] strategy: str
class StakeholderMapping(BaseModel): champions: Group key_players: Group subjects: Group crowd: Group

step.name: develop_engagement
step.system: You develop engagement tactics for each stakeholder group.
step.response_schema:
class Engagement(BaseModel): group_name: str approach: str channels: list[str] frequency: str
class EngagementStrategy(BaseModel): strategies: list[Engagement]
